text: I did receive credit to my account for the amount of XXXX from a local store called XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX For groceries that were undesirable and were sent back, I was credited the amount of XXXX by said Store as well as from Wells Fargo Bank. For the last few days, the Money disappeared from my account. Called them numerous times and was given the run around by the Fraud dept. claim Number XXXX. Will also be putting in a complaint against the store that was supposed to be credited back my Money in the said amount of XXXX There is no transaction on my account anywhere of that amount, it just magically disappeared I know how much money I had in my account, and Wells Fargo just wiped it off of my account. I have been with this Bank for fourteen years, and as soon as this is taken care of I am closing my account with them. Bank Fraud on their part.
